newsitem.title: UK: High protein soymeal sharply lower on UK meals/feeds.
newsitem.headline: High protein soymeal sharply lower on UK meals/feeds.

text.p: High protein soymeal prices fell sharply on the UK meals and feeds market following heavy falls on the Chicago futures.
Sellers of high pro were as much as eight stg a tonne down, but brokers said although interest was brewing buyers were holding back for lower prices.
"Soymeal certainly appears to have the skids under it but buyers feel they can afford to wait, said one broker.
Ex-mill high pro was offered unchanged for April while forwards positions were eight stg down to unchanged.
Ex-store offers were around seven stg lower.
The remainder of the market was unchanged.
